task: Bounded full-text and official-source audit of label-noise dual-entry augmentation question

search.engine: web search; public primary-source websites; GitHub connector for official code
queries: "Augmentation Strategies for Learning with Noisy Labels" github
"AdaAug: Learning Class- and Instance-adaptive Data Augmentation Policies"
search.query_log_basis: Query text from this task's tool-call record; no claim of systematic or exhaustive literature coverage
search.stop_reason: Sufficient bounded evidence for non-greenlight decision; do not expand search to force a candidate

scientific_decision.retained_deliverable: conditional classroom mechanism-audit protocol, not a new method
scientific_decision.investment_gate_from_previous_temperatur: not_reused; no scientific equivalence or mechanism-null claim

primary_papers.title: Sample-aware RandAugment: Search-free Automatic Data Augmentation for Effective Image Recognition
primary_papers.scope: Sections 2, 3.1–3.3, equations 1–2 and algorithm; official implementation data flow. Earlier screening already examined experiments.
primary_papers.dependence: Current label directly enters MIS; supervised loss uses same observed label in released loop.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Formula dependence is already explicit. Exact oracle label-routing four-cell ablation not identified in read portions; not an exhaustive absence claim.

primary_papers.title: Augmentation Strategies for Learning with Noisy Labels
primary_papers.scope: Sections 3.1–3.4, 4.1–4.7 including weak/strong comparisons, Appendix A.1–A.3 algorithms; official CIFAR train/dataloader/config/RA.
primary_papers.dependence: Image transforms accept image only; CE loss modeling and target refinement use observed label.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Already separates augmentation for loss analysis/pseudo-labeling from gradient update. WW/SS/WS is not independent oracle labels for controller and loss.
primary_papers.version_caveat: dataloader eval_train uses test transform; author note says intended weak augmentation, negligible impact not independently verified. RandAugment stores m but samples random strength.

primary_papers.title: AutoDO: Robust AutoAugment for Biased Data with Label Noise via Scalable Probabilistic Implicit Differentiation
primary_papers.scope: Sections 3–5, augmentation/weights/soft-label joint optimization and A/AW/AWS ablations; official implicit-augment.py and automodels.py.
primary_papers.dependence: Fixed augmentation model accepts index,image; observed labels and validation supervision influence learned hyperparameters through optimization.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Joint label-noise and augmentation optimization is prior art; not same fixed SRA four-cell routing.

primary_papers.title: Learning with Imbalanced Noisy Data by Preventing Bias in Sample Selection
primary_papers.scope: Sections III-B–D, IV-D; official main.py robust_train path.
primary_papers.dependence: Current observed label affects clean pool and p_y threshold; fixed-pool Mixup weight ordering uses max softmax, while pseudo-target also uses label.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Confidence controlled augmentation and noise routing are established; component ablations read do not show exact oracle four-cell routing.

primary_papers.title: CTW: Confident Time-Warping for Time-Series Label-Noise Learning
primary_papers.scope: Main text sections 3, 4.3–4.4 and visible component ablation table; official training helper and two experiment shell scripts read as text only. Supplementary PDF not read.
primary_papers.dependence: CE and classwise selection use noisy labels; selected data are time-warped then supervised with corresponding noisy targets.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Direct prior for avoiding indiscriminate noisy-data augmentation; time-series domain; all/confident and component ablations differ from oracle two-label routing.

primary_papers.title: LA3: Efficient Label-Aware AutoAugment
primary_papers.scope: Sections 3.2–3.3, 4.4; official dataset policy[target] and training loss.
primary_papers.dependence: Current target directly selects class policy and is returned for supervised loss.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: The generic label-used-twice mechanism already exists; exact noisy/clean two-entry experiment not identified in read sections.

primary_papers.title: AdaAugment: A Tuning-Free and Adaptive Approach to Enhance Data Augmentation
primary_papers.scope: Section III reward/state/action and IV-G/H analyses/ablations; official train.py, A2C.py, dataset and WRN forward.
primary_papers.dependence: Label directly enters policy reward through three CE terms, thus future actions/cache. Audited WRN labels formal argument is unused in its forward body.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Distinct from current-score SRA but closes generic adaptive label-conditioned training feedback claim. AdaAug (ICLR 2022) is a different paper.

primary_papers.title: EntAugment: Entropy-Driven Adaptive Data Augmentation Framework for Image Classification
primary_papers.scope: Method Section 3.1–3.2 and algorithm; official train_EntAugment.py and cached-magnitude dataset.
primary_papers.dependence: Entropy magnitude does not directly use observed label at fixed logits; CE changes future model. Cached update timing differs from extra-score-forward SRA.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Potential score-level negative control only; entire method is not a perfectly matched baseline and is not noise-immune.

primary_papers.title: SelectMix: Enhancing Label Noise Robustness through Targeted Sample Mixing
primary_papers.scope: Method and alpha ablations; Appendix B Algorithm 1, Appendix C settings.
primary_papers.dependence: Given-label/OOF mismatch selects mixing; given label determines partner class pool and contributes to soft target.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Very close generic double-entry prior; exact oracle independent-label grid not identified. No author-linked official code confirmed; search failure is not proof code is unavailable.

primary_papers.title: On-the-Fly Data Augmentation via Gradient-Guided and Sample-Aware Influence Estimation
primary_papers.dependence: Derivation uses label, efficient approximation replaces one-hot labels with current predictions. Released-code behavior unverified.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Do not misclassify efficient score as current observed-label dependence based solely on intermediate derivation.

primary_papers.title: When to Learn What: Model-Adaptive Data Augmentation Curriculum
primary_papers.scope: Section 3, equations and joint-training algorithm; code link observed but not audited.
primary_papers.dependence: Feature-input policy learned through train/validation objectives, according to paper.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Background on indirect label dependence; not used as proof of exact coverage.

primary_papers.title: ActiveAugment: Online Active Learning for Augmentation Selection in Deep Learning
primary_papers.scope: Sections 3–4 selection/learning and evaluation; official link observed but no code audit.
primary_papers.dependence: Paper uses predictive informativeness and feature displacement for selection; supervised terms use labels. Individual strategy implementations unverified.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Recent proximity check; not evidence that oracle label-routing study was already done.

primary_papers.title: ExploreAugment (exact version/authorship not verified from full text)
primary_papers.scope: Search lead only; full-text attempt redirected to challenge.
primary_papers.novelty_boundary: Snippet not used to confirm or exclude duplication; do not clear novelty against this work.

limitations: No empirical risk estimate for the new hypothesis.
Four-grid alone does not identify special harm of identical incorrect class reused twice.
Control-label changes alter both average magnitude and sample allocation.
Entropy-based direct-label independence does not imply immunity to training-label noise.
Absence of a located four-grid is not proof of no prior art.
CPU training wall-clock and semantic validity of toy-data operator pool not measured.
